title: 咘咘和夜晚的圣索菲亚
title_en: Bubu and Saint Sophia at Night

pages.text: 封面：夜晚的圣索菲亚教堂灯光亮起；咘咘站在最前面，爸爸妈妈、爷爷奶奶、外公外婆温暖地围在身边。
pages.text_en: Cover: The lights of Saint Sophia Cathedral glow at night. Bubu stands in front while Dad, Mom, Grandpa, Grandma, Maternal Grandpa, and Maternal Grandma gather warmly around her.

pages.text: 今天，咘咘要飞到很远很远的哈尔滨。
pages.text_en: Today, Bubu is flying far, far away to Harbin.

pages.text: 飞机飞进云朵里，咘咘从小窗户看见软软的白云。
pages.text_en: The airplane flies into the clouds, and Bubu sees soft white clouds through the little window.

pages.text: “我们到哈尔滨啦！”爸爸开心地说。
pages.text_en: “We are in Harbin!” Dad says happily.

pages.text: 北方的空气凉凉的。咘咘穿着厚厚的衣服，还是觉得有一点冷。
pages.text_en: The northern air feels cool. Bubu wears warm clothes, but she still feels a little chilly.

pages.text: 妈妈牵住咘咘的小手，爷爷奶奶和外公外婆也走在身边。
pages.text_en: Mom holds Bubu’s little hand, while Grandpa, Grandma, Maternal Grandpa, and Maternal Grandma walk beside them.

pages.text: 晚上，大家来到一座特别特别漂亮的大教堂前。
pages.text_en: That evening, everyone comes to a very, very beautiful cathedral.

pages.text: 圆圆的大屋顶像一颗大洋葱，绿色的小尖顶高高地指向天空。
pages.text_en: The round roof looks like a great onion, and little green spires point high into the sky.

pages.text: “这是圣索菲亚教堂。”爸爸轻轻告诉咘咘。
pages.text_en: “This is Saint Sophia Cathedral,” Dad tells Bubu softly.

pages.text: 夜幕慢慢落下，大教堂的灯一盏一盏亮起来。
pages.text_en: Night slowly falls, and the cathedral lights turn on one by one.

pages.text: 金色的灯光照着圆圆的屋顶，也照亮了咘咘亮晶晶的眼睛。
pages.text_en: Golden light shines on the round roof and lights up Bubu’s sparkling eyes.

pages.text: 咘咘抬起头，好想把这座漂亮的大教堂看个够。
pages.text_en: Bubu looks up. She wants to admire the beautiful cathedral forever.

pages.text: 爸爸妈妈、爷爷奶奶、外公外婆陪她在广场上慢慢走、慢慢看。
pages.text_en: Dad, Mom, Grandpa, Grandma, Maternal Grandpa, and Maternal Grandma walk slowly with her through the square and look around.

pages.text: 咘咘说：“圣索菲亚教堂晚上像一座发光的城堡！”
pages.text_en: Bubu says, “Saint Sophia Cathedral looks like a glowing castle at night!”

pages.text: 大家一起拍下第一张哈尔滨全家福。
pages.text_en: Everyone takes their first Harbin family photo together.

pages.text: 看完教堂，一家人来到新的酒店。
pages.text_en: After seeing the cathedral, the family arrives at their new hotel.

pages.text: 新房间有软软的大床。咘咘钻进暖暖的被窝，觉得一点也不冷了。
pages.text_en: The new room has a soft big bed. Bubu snuggles into the warm covers and does not feel cold at all.

pages.text: 晚安，亮闪闪的圣索菲亚。晚安，哈尔滨的第一夜。
pages.text_en: Good night, shining Saint Sophia. Good night, Harbin’s first evening.
